description: This file defines the 'LatinKeyboard' class, a subclass of Android's Keyboard class, which manages the layout and behavior of a custom Latin-based soft keyboard, including handling special keys like Enter, Space, Mode Change, and Language Switch, and dynamically adjusting key visibility and options based on input method editor (IME) states.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard
classes.description: A subclass of Keyboard that manages a Latin-character based soft keyboard, supporting dynamic key layout adjustments such as showing/hiding the language switch key and updating the Enter key label based on IME options.

classes.name: LatinKeyboard.LatinKey
classes.description: A customized Key class within LatinKeyboard that overrides the 'isInside' method to fine-tune the touch target area for specific keys.

methods.name: createKeyFromXml
methods.description: Creates and returns a Key object from XML, initializing references for specific keys like enter, space, mode change, and language switch.

methods.name: setLanguageSwitchKeyVisibility
methods.description: Dynamically updates the visibility of the language switch key (globe button). When hidden, the size of the mode change key expands to occupy the space.

methods.name: setImeOptions
methods.description: Sets the label and icon of the Enter key based on IME options, such as action go, next, search, or send.

methods.name: setSpaceIcon
methods.description: Updates the icon displayed on the space key.
